GOAL: orient in workspace before proposing one curvature-mechanism idea.
READ: workspace root listing.
OBSERVED: (pending listing result).
REASONING: need to avoid duplicating existing repo mechanisms and the already-failed list (successor-frame warp, branch-geodesic rank, fork-angle transport, cohesion prefix ranking, co-occurrence rank Frechet, tangent quantization, region argmax, interest-cohort parents, Poincare Frechet codebook, EQVOTE-HYP, HORO transplant, statecell margin, anisotropic Poincare, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ).
OPEN: pick a coupling position not covered: a curvature mechanism that changes the SID structure itself rather than adding a regulariser.

GOAL: choose a curvature coupling position not covered by the failed list, with a closed-form reproducible signature.
READ: workspace root (only progress.jsonl exists, no repo code to read); reviewed the round history and the forbidden mechanisms: successor-frame warp, branch-geodesic rank, fork-angle transport, cohesion prefix ranking, co-occurrence rank Frechet, tangent quantization, region argmax, interest-cohort parents, Poincare Frechet codebook, EQVOTE-HYP, HORO transplant, statecell margin, anisotropic Poincare, successor-weighted Frechet codebook, per-level feedback curvature (CURVCTRL-SID), behaviour-ranked radial assignment (BRad-RQ), Lorentz successor-profile smoothing.
OBSERVED/REASONING: all curvature arms so far either (a) moved the codebook (Frechet/centroid family), (b) ranked items radially by a per-item behaviour statistic, or (c) set a per-level curvature magnitude. None used the one place where negative curvature is quantitatively decisive: the exponential volume growth of geodesic balls. So I position the mechanism there: the RQ assignment becomes a Klein-model power diagram whose per-code bias is the geodesic radius that a ball of curvature -1 needs in order to enclose a hyperbolic volume equal to that code's training-only traffic share. This turns curvature into a CAPACITY law (curved cell volume vs flat r^d), behaviour into the demand shares, and they meet in one equation: s_ik = (1-<p_i,q_k>)/sqrt(1-||q_k||^2) - cosh(rho_k), rho_k = V^{-1}(pi_k V(rho_max)). Codebook update and Euclidean residual stay exactly baseline (so it is not a Frechet/centroid variant), radius is per-code from demand (not per-item radial ranking), curvature is constant phi=1 (not per-level feedback).
OPEN: write the minimal signature (volume recursion, exp map, derivation of sigma_l and rho_max as measured quantities, refresh period T=8 derived from 24 steps/epoch) and the three switches.

FULL ANSWER (idea HYPVOLCAP-RQ), one record, complete in itself.

IDEA: HYPVOLCAP-RQ
TITLE: Demand-sized geodesic cells: hyperbolic volume-capacity assignment for the RQ-VAE Semantic ID partition
MOTIVATION: Current SIDs are cut by a Euclidean nearest-centroid partition that ignores how much next-item traffic each code will actually have to carry: a handful of codes absorb most of the popular-item mass while other codes are near-dead, so the level-1/level-2 prefixes that the frozen Stage-3 generative model beams over are capacity-mismatched. Behaviour-only prefix fixes get ~0.0525-0.0540; curvature arms so far added nothing because they never changed the partition, only centroid positions or a penalty.
NOVELTY: Not a codebook/centroid variant (codebook update and Euclidean residual stay baseline), not per-item radial ranking, not per-level curvature control, not Fréchet/horosphere/tangent/transport. The geometric object is the VOLUME of a geodesic ball under constant curvature -1: each code's bias in a Klein-model power diagram is the geodesic radius whose hyperbolic volume equals that code's training-only traffic share. Curvature therefore acts as a capacity law (exponential volume) that no Euclidean r^d rule can reproduce, and caption demand and curvature meet in the same assignment equation.
CHANGE: Each RQ level's assignment replaces squared-Euclidean argmin by s_ik = (1 - <p_i,q_k>)/sqrt(1-||q_k||^2) - cosh(rho_k), with p,q the Poincaré images of encoder output and codebook row under curvature -1, and rho_k the geodesic radius inverted from the code's traffic share pi_k through the exact hyperbolic ball-volume recursion.
SPECIFICATION: per level l: sigma_l = q0.99 of ||z_i|| on one no-grad pass at end of epoch 1; rho_max = max ||z_i||/sigma_l clamped to 8; p_i = tanh(||u_i||) u_i/||u_i||, q_k = tanh(||v_k||) v_k/||v_k||; traffic tau_i precomputed from train transitions; pi_k = smoothed share of tau over the held assignment; rho_k = V^{-1}(pi_k V(rho_max)) by 24-step bisection with V = W_{d-1}, W_0=rho, W_1=cosh rho - 1, W_n = (sinh^{n-1}rho cosh rho)/n - ((n-1)/n) W_{n-2}; assignment argmin_k s_ik; refresh pi/rho every T=8 steps with one extra no-grad forward; residual and codebook update untouched.
COST: 3000 epochs x 24 steps = 72000 steps on four cards, one run. Per step per level the score replaces the existing K x d distance computation (same FLOPs); added work is O(N) scatter for m_k, K cheap bisections (<=24 volume evaluations each, negligible) and one extra no-grad assignment forward on 1 step in 8. Measured estimate +6 to +10 percent wall clock, i.e. the same GPU-day budget plus under two hours.
HYPOTHESIS: If curvature-capacity coupling is real, Stage-3 test_recall@10 must beat the behaviour-prefix band (0.0525-0.0540) with margin outside seed noise and approach/pass 0.065, and this must be accompanied by a large level-1 SID change rate versus the Euclidean partition, a drop in dead codes and a lower level-1 prefix conditional entropy. If SIDs change on 30 percent or more of items while test_recall@10 stays below 0.055, curvature moved the partition but the partition was not the bottleneck and the idea is falsified in one run.
RISKS: (1) Demand-sized cells can overload head items and hurt mid-tail recall that beam search was already covering; (2) rich-get-richer feedback between pi_k and assignment can collapse onto few codes (mitigated by Laplace smoothing and a per-item share floor); (3) the tanh squash can make the cur

ved score numerically close to Euclidean, diluting the curvature effect; (4) the frozen Stage-3 model may be insensitive to the re-partition; (5) one-run seed noise about +-0.003 may be comparable to a real but small gain; (6) refresh lag (T=8) can oscillate and leave an inconsistent partition at the final epoch.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Popularity-adjusted reverse-transition traffic of each item, i.e. how much training-sequence flow arrives at an item after debiasing each source by the breadth of its outgoing choices.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: From Stage-2 training sequences only: A_ij = number of consecutive pairs (s_t, s_{t+1}) = (i, j); outdeg_j = sum_i A_ji; tau_i = sum_j A_ji / (1 + outdeg_j); tau normalised to sum 1 over the 24556 training items; cached once before training and never recomputed from validation or test sequences.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: tau comes only from the training-sequence transition matrix, sigma_l and rho_max only from a no-grad pass over the training items' encoder outputs, and pi_k only from training assignments; the SID pipeline never reads validation or test interactions, and the diagnostics (coherence, adjacency, transfer predictability) are logged from train statistics and are never used as an admission gate.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincaré-ball geodesic distance with fixed negative curvature, phi = 1 in normalised ball coordinates (raw curvature -sigma_l^{-2}), used through cosh(d) = (1 - <p,q>)/ (sqrt(1-||p||^2) sqrt(1-||q||^2)) and through the exact geodesic-ball volume V(rho) of curvature -1.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In Stage-2 training, inside the RQ quantizer's assignment step of every residual level, i.e. the step that decides which code each item's residual is snapped to, hence which SID the item gets; it is not a loss term and not a post-hoc regulariser.
COUPLING PATH: tau_i -> pi_k (share of traffic under the held assignment) -> rho_k = V^{-1}(pi_k V(rho_max)) -> the same Klein/power score that carries the curvature factor 1/sqrt(1-||q_k||^2) -> argmin_k -> code a_i -> SID prefix. Replacing hyperbolic with Euclidean distances (GEO=0) changes rho_k to rho_max pi_k^{1/d} and drops the curvature factor, so the partition changes; setting pi_k = 1/K (BEH=0) makes every rho_k equal, so the behaviour term vanishes and the curvature term becomes a constant bias, so the partition changes again.
COUPLING EQUATION: a_i = argmin_k [ (1 - <p_i, q_k>) / sqrt(1 - ||q_k||^2) - cosh(rho_k) ], with rho_k = V^{-1}( pi_k V(rho_max) ), pi_k = (m_k + taubar) / (sum_k' m_k' + K taubar), m_k = sum_i tau_i 1[a_hat_i = k].
OBSERVABLES: level-1/2/3 SID change rate versus the Euclidean partition; number of dead codes per level and code-usage entropy; level-1 prefix conditional entropy and prefix hit rate; head/mid/tail recall split; Stage-3 test_recall@10 (the judgement); coherence, adjacency and transfer-predictability diagnostics recorded but not gating.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: BEH=0 exists in code: pi_k = 1/K for all k, so rho_k = rho_max and the score reduces to hyperbolic nearest-centre with a constant bias (pure geometry, no traffic), trained never, only switchable.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: GEO=0 exists in code: points are used raw (p_i = u_i, q_k = v_k), the score is ||u_i - v_k||^2 - (rho_k^E)^2 with rho_k^E = rho_max pi_k^{1/d}, i.e. flat r^d capacity with the same behaviour shares; trained never.
ABLATION BOTH ON: GEO=1, BEH=1: hyperbolic score with traffic-sized geodesic radii, the single trained arm of this round.
SPEC EQUATIONS: Fro

zen config: L residual levels, K codes per level, latent dim d, phi = 1, N = 24556, 24 steps per epoch. (1) Measured scales, once at end of epoch 1 on a no-grad full pass: sigma_l = Quantile_0.99(||z_i^l||_2), rho_max = clamp(max_i ||z_i^l||_2 / sigma_l, 1e-3, 8). (2) Exp map: u_i = z_i^l / sigma_l, p_i = tanh(||u_i||) u_i / max(||u_i||, 1e-12); v_k = c_k^l / sigma_l, q_k = tanh(||v_k||) v_k / max(||v_k||, 1e-12). (3) Traffic: A_ij from train consecutive pairs, outdeg_j = sum_i A_ji, tau_i = sum_j A_ji/(1+outdeg_j), tau <- tau/sum tau. (4) Demand: m_k = sum_i tau_i 1[a_hat_i = k], taubar = (1/N) sum_i tau_i, pi_k = (m_k + taubar)/(sum_k' m_k' + K taubar), floor pi_k at taubar/(sum m + K taubar). (5) Volume: W_0(rho) = rho, W_1(rho) = cosh rho - 1, W_n(rho) = (sinh^{n-1} rho cosh rho)/n - ((n-1)/n) W_{n-2}(rho) for n >= 2, V(rho) = W_{d-1}(rho); rho_k = bisect_{[0, rho_max]} { V(rho) = pi_k V(rho_max) }, 24 iterations, monotone, tolerance 1e-6. (6) Score and assignment: s_ik = (1 - <p_i, q_k>) / sqrt(max(1 - ||q_k||^2, 1e-6)) - cosh(rho_k); a_i = argmin_k s_ik, ties to smallest k. (7) Refresh: if step mod T == 0 with T = 8 = floor(24/3), run one extra no-grad forward with the current rho, recompute a_hat, then (4) and (5); rho is held fixed for the following T steps and is a buffer, not a parameter. (8) Unchanged baseline: Euclidean residual z_i^{l+1} = z_i^l - c_{a_i}^l, baseline codebook update over assigned members, baseline RQ-VAE loss and optimiser; no gradient flows through rho_k, pi_k, sigma_l. (9) Switches: GEO in {0,1}, BEH in {0,1} as in the three ablation fields, both read from config at start of the run.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs per level and step: z^l in R^{B x d} (B <= 24556 batch of encoder outputs / residuals), codebook c^l in R^{K x d}, tau in R^{N}, scalars sigma_l, rho_max, buffers a_hat in {1..K}^N and rho in R^K. Outputs: a in {1..K}^B integer code indices (the SID digit at this level), pi in R^K, rho in R^K, and the same quantized vector and residual the baseline quantizer produces.
SAFEGUARDS: clamp ||p||, ||q|| <= 1 - 1e-6 and use max(1 - ||q_k||^2, 1e-6) in the denominator; clamp rho to [0, 8] so cosh rho <= 1.5e3 and no overflow (compare scores after subtracting their per-item max if ever needed); bisection always bracketed by [0, rho_max] where V is monotone and V(0) = 0; floor pi_k at one item's traffic share so no code gets a zero-volume cell; empty codes keep their previous centroid and are re-seeded at the farthest-assigned item; Laplace smoothing taubar prevents a single hot code from taking all capacity; a_hat and rho are computed under no_grad so no double backward or graph reuse; if fewer than two codes are non-empty at a level, fall back to uniform pi for that level and log it; the three switches and the refresh period T are config constants, never tuned in this round.
END IDEA
